dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Low to moderate visibility; thin, light-colored lines are formed by the pale tips of the greater and median coverts, appearing as a series of scalloped edges rather than solid, high-contrast horizontal bars.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, prominent pale edges are clearly visible along the boundaries of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers against the darker feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and non-linear transition boundary separating the uniform brown-gray crown from the patterned mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct and repetitive scaled patterning across the entire dorsal surface, defined by dark, teardrop-shaped feather centers and broad, pale buffy-gray margins.
